app.title: Honeyhollow
app.tagline: Build a busy little town, one click at a time.

app.free: Honeyhollow is completely free. There is nothing to buy, ever.
hud.energyOver: Bonus energy above your cap - spend it!
hud.goodsTip: {cur} / {cap} goods stored. Build barns and silos for more room.
hud.volunteersTip: {n} volunteers ready to staff buildings. +1 every 4 hours (max {max}).
mood.happy: Residents are happy - build more homes!
mood.content: Getting crowded - build community buildings to raise the cap.
mood.sad: Very crowded! Raise the population cap with community buildings.

tools.expandHint: Tap a sign to buy that land.

energy.body: Energy comes back by itself: +1 every {mins} minutes. Next one in {time}.

staff.askFriends: Ask friends to take a job
staff.posted: Job request posted - friends will see it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityNote: Redraws the art in more detail as you zoom in. Turn it off to save memory on older devices.
settings.dayNightNote: After dark, windows, street lamps and headlights light up. Night never changes your timers or earnings.

settings.keys: Keyboard: R rotate · M move · Esc cancel · +/- zoom · B build · arrows pan
bonus.label: Bonus bar
intro.title: Welcome to Honeyhollow!
intro.body: Hi, Mayor! I'm Hazel, the town planner. Honeyhollow is small, but it's ours - and it's buzzing to grow. Your goals are on the left. Let's start by collecting some rent!
intro.free: Everything here is earned by playing. No shops, no ads, no catch.
goal.tut_rent.title: Rent Day
goal.tut_rent.text: The Honeycomb Cottage has rent waiting. Click the house with the coin bubble to collect it!
goal.tut_harvest.title: Bumper Crop
goal.tut_harvest.text: Those strawberries are ripe! Click both plots to harvest them into goods for your shops.
goal.tut_plant.title: Seeds of Success
goal.tut_plant.text: An empty plot is a sad plot. Click a plot and plant strawberries - they're ready in 5 minutes.
goal.tut_home.title: Home Sweet Home
goal.tut_home.text: New neighbors want to move in! Open Build, choose a Honeycomb Cottage, place it beside a road and click it to build.
goal.tut_bakery.title: Fresh Bread
goal.tut_bakery.text: Every town needs a bakery. Place a Butterbun Bakery next to a road and build it.
goal.tut_supply.title: Stock the Shelves
goal.tut_supply.text: Shops only open when fully stocked. Click your new bakery to fill it with goods.
goal.tut_sale.title: First Customers
goal.tut_sale.text: Watch the townsfolk shop! When a money bag appears, click the bakery to collect.
goal.tut_berries.title: Berry Good
goal.tut_berries.text: Your strawberries will be ripe soon. Harvest 2 of them before they wither!
goal.tut_roads.title: Paving the Way
goal.tut_roads.text: More roads, more room! Place 2 road pieces from the Roads tab - they connect automatically.
goal.tut_decor.title: Curb Appeal
goal.tut_decor.text: Decorations make nearby homes and shops pay more. Place 2 near your bakery!
goal.tut_townhall.title: Town Hall
goal.tut_townhall.text: Build a Town Hall to make room for more residents. When the frame is up, staff it with volunteers.
goal.tut_bonus.title: Bonus Buzz
goal.tut_bonus.text: Collect rewards quickly, one after another, to fill the bonus bar in the corner. Reach 'Bonus!' for extra coins.
goal.tut_pop.title: Room to Grow
goal.tut_pop.text: Let's grow Honeyhollow to 30 residents. Homes add residents - keep building!
goal.tut_farm.title: Bigger Fields
goal.tut_farm.text: More plots, more goods. Place 2 more farm plots from the Farming tab.
goal.tut_level.title: Mayor in Training
goal.tut_level.text: You're a natural! Reach level 5 and you'll have the whole town buzzing.
goal.g_bungalow.title: Moving Up
goal.g_bungalow.text: Families love the Clover Bungalow's big porch. Build one!
goal.g_florist.title: Say It With Flowers
goal.g_florist.text: A Petal Cart would brighten any corner. Build one once you have 30 residents.
goal.g_harvest10.title: Farmhand
goal.g_harvest10.text: Keep those fields busy! Harvest 10 crops.
goal.g_collect.title: Collector's Eye
goal.g_collect.text: Shiny little things pop out as you play. Find 3 collectibles.
goal.g_cafe.title: Morning Buzz
goal.g_cafe.text: Nothing wakes a town like coffee. Build the Bean & Bee Café.
goal.g_rent10.title: Landlord
goal.g_rent10.text: Collect rent 10 times. Short-timer homes pay often!
goal.g_postoffice.title: Special Delivery
goal.g_postoffice.text: Letters are piling up! Build the Pigeon Post Office.
goal.g_decor6.title: Prettier Streets
goal.g_decor6.text: Own 8 decorations. Put them within 3 tiles of homes and shops for bonuses.
goal.g_redeem.title: Complete Set
goal.g_redeem.text: Finish any 5-item collection and redeem it for a prize.
goal.g_silo.title: More Room
goal.g_silo.text: Goods need a home. Build a Grain Silo to store more.
goal.g_daily.title: Daily Visit
goal.g_daily.text: Drop by every day! Claim the daily bonus 3 times.
goal.g_inn.title: Tourist Season
goal.g_inn.text: Visitors spend double! Build the Honeypot Inn to bring tourists to town.
goal.g_pop100.title: Bustling Burg
goal.g_pop100.text: Reach 100 residents. Remember: community buildings raise the cap.
goal.g_toyshop.title: Playtime
goal.g_toyshop.text: The kids have spoken: build Tinker Toys!
goal.g_corn.title: Corn Country
goal.g_corn.text: Corn takes a day but gives lots of goods - perfect for overnight. Plant 2.
goal.g_sales20.title: Shopkeeper's Pride
goal.g_sales20.text: Collect from your shops 20 times. Restock them right away to keep sales flowing.
goal.g_firestation.title: Safety First
goal.g_firestation.text: Build the Ember Lane Fire Station - the whole town will sleep better.
coll.where.toybox: Tinker Toys and the billiards hall
coll.where.diner: burgers, the diner and the inn
coll.where.harvestfest: anything you do during the Harvest Festival
a11y.game: City view. Use the toolbar buttons or keyboard shortcuts.
expand.title: Expand your land
expand.body: Room to grow! Each new lot of land costs coins, needs enough residents to fill it, and zoning permits from the council.
expand.permitsHow: Permits come from goals, collections, the daily bonus, level-ups and neighbor gifts.
gifts.title: Gifts & help
gifts.none: Nothing waiting right now. Neighbors drop by every day!
account.guest: You are playing as a guest. Your city is saved in this browser on this device.
account.guestBackup: Tip: export a save file from Settings to keep a backup or move your city to another device.
neighbors.soon: Neighbors live along the bottom bar.
import.confirm: Load {city} (level {level})? This replaces the city in this browser.
boost.goldenharvest.on: Golden Harvest! Crops give double goods for 10 minutes.
boost.rushhour.on: Rush Hour! Shops sell twice as fast and pay +50% for 10 minutes.
tip.dockFree: Dock {n}: free - click to send a boat
tip.shipBack: Dock {n}: boat is back! Click to unload
tip.trainBack: The train is back! Click to welcome it
tip.wonderReady: Ready! Click to fire its town-wide boost
char.hazel.cheer: Wonderful work, Mayor! Honeyhollow is buzzing.
char.barnaby.cheer: Well, I'll be! That's some mighty fine farming.
char.marigold.cheer: Shipshape work, Mayor! Fair winds ahead.
place.coast: Must be built on the shore.
err.coast: Must be built on the shore, facing the sea.
visit.noHelps: No help actions left here today - come back tomorrow!
visit.nothing: Nothing to help with here right now. Try a crop, an open shop or a building site.
visit.allUsed: {name} says thanks for all your help today!
pier.intro: Send boats out on contracts. When they come back, click the pier to unload their goods (1 energy).
train.title: Railway Station
train.locked: The railway opens at level {level}. Keep growing Honeyhollow!
train.back: The train is back at the station!
train.away: The train is out on its route. Back in {time}.
train.intro: Buy goods with coins, or sell spare goods for coins. Every neighbor you add as a stop makes the trip pay more.
train.stopsHint: Tap a neighbor to add or remove them as a stop.
boost.goldenharvest.desc: Ring the Great Honey Hive for a Golden Harvest: every crop gives double goods for {mins} minutes!
boost.rushhour.desc: Light up the Sky Garden for Rush Hour: shops sell twice as fast and pay 50% more for {mins} minutes!
wonder.useKeys: Recharge now with {n} Wonder Keys (you have {have})
wonder.keysHow: Wonder Keys come from goals, level-ups, the daily bonus and neighbor gifts.
parts.title: Building parts
parts.body: The frame of the {name} is up! It needs building parts before it can open.
parts.how: Parts come from goals, collections, long boat trips, trains, helping neighbors and neighbor gifts.
upgrade.title: Upgrade (level {level} of {max})
upgrade.shop: Next level: stock and pay {pct}% more per delivery.
upgrade.pier: Next level: a longer dock with room for {n} boats.
online.offline: Couldn't reach the server. You can keep playing - your city is saved on this device.
online.noServer: This copy of Honeyhollow runs without a server, so accounts and friends are not available. Everything else works in guest mode.
online.needAccount: Create a free account to add friends, visit their towns and keep your city in the cloud. No email needed.
online.inviteNeedsServer: Friend invites need the online server, which is not available right now.
online.saveRejected: The cloud didn't accept this save. Your city is still saved on this device.
online.conflictBody: Your account has a city saved in the cloud that differs from the one on this device. Which one do you want to keep playing?
online.staffed: {who} took a job in your town!
online.cityUnavailable: That city can't be visited right now.
online.helpFailed: That help didn't go through. Try something else.
online.inviteSignIn: Someone invited you to be their neighbor! Sign in or create a free account to accept.
online.inviteAdd: Add the player with friend code {code} as your neighbor?
online.friend_notFound: No player has that friend code.
online.noFriends: No neighbors yet. Share your code or invite link with friends!
online.leaderboardBody: Experience earned this week by you and your neighbors. Resets every Monday.
online.giftLimit: You can send one free gift per neighbor per day.
account.signedOut: Signed out. Your city stays saved on this device.
account.why: An account lets you play on any device, add neighbors and help each other. Only a username and password - no email.
account.noEmail: We never ask for your email or real name.
account.err_rate: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
account.err_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, your cloud save and your neighbor links. The city saved on this device stays. Enter your password to confirm.
account.recoveryBody: Write this code down somewhere safe. It is the only way to reset your password, because we never ask for an email.
goal.n_visitpip.title: Meet the Neighbors
goal.n_visitpip.text: Pip runs a little farm hamlet called Thistledown Meadow. Visit from the neighbor bar and say hello!
goal.n_visitrosa.title: Seaside Hello
goal.n_visitrosa.text: Rosa keeps Driftwood Bay ship-shape by the sea. Drop by for a visit!
goal.n_help10.title: Good Neighbor
goal.n_help10.text: Neighbors help neighbors! Use 10 help actions in your neighbors' towns - harvest, water, send tour buses.
goal.n_gifts5.title: Thank-You Notes
goal.n_gifts5.text: Neighbors send gifts every day. Open the gift box and accept 5 of them.
goal.m_expand1.title: Room to Roam
goal.m_expand1.text: Ahoy, Mayor! Honeyhollow needs more land. Tap a For Sale sign at the edge of town to expand.
goal.m_pier.title: Shipshape
goal.m_pier.text: A town by the sea needs a harbor! Build the Harbor Pier on the shore - I'll handle the boats.
goal.m_ship3.title: Anchors Aweigh
goal.m_ship3.text: Send 3 boats out on trading contracts from your pier.
goal.m_unload5.title: Cargo Day
goal.m_unload5.text: Unload 5 boats when they come home. Long voyages even bring back building parts!
goal.m_train1.title: All Aboard!
goal.m_train1.text: The railway station on the edge of town is open from level 5. Send your first train!
goal.m_train5.title: Rail Baron
goal.m_train5.text: Welcome 5 trains back home. Add neighbors as stops for bigger loads.
goal.u_upgrade1.title: Bigger and Better
goal.u_upgrade1.text: Upgraded shops stock more and pay more. Click a shop and upgrade it - you will need some building parts.
goal.u_mastery.title: Master Baker
goal.u_mastery.text: Practice makes perfect: collect from bakeries 25 times to earn a mastery star.
goal.f_harvest50.title: Harvest Moon
goal.f_harvest50.text: Fifty harvests! Keep those plots busy, Mayor.
goal.f_bigbarn.title: Barn Raising
goal.f_bigbarn.text: Goods are piling up. Raise a Big Barn to store them.
goal.c_library.title: Quiet, Please
goal.c_library.text: Every growing town needs a library. Build the Bookworm Library.
goal.s_diner.title: Comet Rising
goal.s_diner.text: Milkshakes for everyone! Build the Comet Diner once you have 350 residents.
goal.s_billiards.title: Corner Pocket
goal.s_billiards.text: Big shops earn big. Build Corner Pocket Billiards and ring it with decorations.
goal.p_pop300.title: Small Town, Big Heart
goal.e_expand3.title: Land Ho!
goal.e_expand3.text: Expand your land three times. Each new lot needs one more zoning permit than the last.
goal.h_townhouse.title: Townhouse Row
goal.h_townhouse.text: Build 2 Maple Townhouses - they pay well and only need collecting twice a day.
goal.w_hive.title: The Great Hive
goal.w_hive.text: Our town symbol, a Great Honey Hive! Build the frame, then deliver bricks, paint and tool kits.
goal.w_boost.title: Golden Hour
goal.w_boost.text: Click the Great Honey Hive to fire a Golden Harvest - double goods from every crop!
goal.w_skygarden.title: Sky High
goal.w_skygarden.text: Build the Sky Garden Tower. Its Rush Hour boost makes every shop sell twice as fast.
goal.l_lighthouse.title: Guiding Light
goal.l_lighthouse.text: Build Lantern Point Lighthouse on the shore to guide the boats home.
goal.l_observatory.title: Stargazers
goal.l_observatory.text: Build the Starfall Observatory - a landmark the whole region will visit.
franchise.requested: {name} wants to open a {shop} on your Empty Lot.
franchise.alreadyThere: You already run one in this town
franchise.placeIntro: Open a copy of one of your shops in {name}'s town. Supply it once a day with half a stock of goods: it pays you coins and stocks {name}'s storage for free.
franchise.noShops: Finish a shop of your own first - then you can open franchises of it in your neighbors' towns.
franchise.taken: That lot (or that kind of shop) is already taken in this town.
franchise.notOwned: Finish building your own copy of that shop first.
franchise.failed: The franchise office couldn't do that right now. Please try again.
franchise.sent: Franchise requested! {name} needs to accept it.
franchise.supplied: Supplied {n} franchises - coins are on their way!
franchise.supplied.one: Supplied 1 franchise - coins are on their way!
franchise.allSupplied: Every franchise is supplied for today. Come back tomorrow!
franchise.hqIntro: Your shops in your neighbors' towns. Supply them once a day: they earn coins and stars, and stock your neighbors' storage.
franchise.none: No franchises yet. Visit a neighbor who has an Empty Lot and tap it to open one.
franchise.waiting: Waiting for your neighbor to accept
franchise.declined: Declined - you get your coins back
franchise.lotOffline: Neighbors can open their shops on this lot as franchises. Sign in to share your friend code and get requests.
franchise.lotEmpty: This lot is free. Neighbors who visit can open a franchise of one of their shops here - share your friend code!
franchise.askAccept: Wants to open on this lot
franchise.requestNote: If you accept, the shop opens on this lot and its daily deliveries fill your storage with free goods.
franchise.closeConfirm: Close {name}'s franchise? The lot becomes free again.
franchise.noGoods: Deliveries arrive when the owner makes their daily supply run.
franchise.opened: {name}'s {shop} is now open in your town!
franchise.npcLot: Franchises open in your online neighbors' towns.
coll.where.winterlights: anything you do during Winter Lights
goal.hf_harvest.title: Harvest Helpers
goal.hf_harvest.text: The Harvest Festival is here! Bring in 10 harvests for the big fair.
goal.hf_decor.title: Festival Spirit
goal.hf_decor.text: Dress up the town: set out 2 Pumpkin Stacks. I left one in your inventory!
goal.hf_ribbon.title: Blue Ribbon Town
goal.hf_ribbon.text: Festival finds turn up everywhere this season. Complete the Harvest Festival collection!
goal.wl_rent.title: Cozy Homes
goal.wl_rent.text: Winter Lights season! Collect rent 15 times while everyone stays in where it is warm.
goal.wl_tree.title: Twinkle Time
goal.wl_tree.text: Put up a Twinkle Tree - wait until dark to see it shine!
goal.wl_glow.title: Glowing Town
goal.wl_glow.text: Collect every Winter Lights find to complete the season.
event.harvestfest.title: The Harvest Festival is on!
event.harvestfest.text: Until November 15: pumpkin decorations in the Seasonal tab, festival finds hidden in everything you do, and goals from Barnaby with prizes.
event.winterlights.title: Winter Lights are here!
event.winterlights.text: Until January 10: snowy decorations in the Seasonal tab, festive finds in everything you do, and seasonal goals with prizes.
ach.title: Achievements
tabs.title: Playing in another tab
tabs.text: Honeyhollow is open in another tab or window. So the two copies can't overwrite each other's progress, this one has paused.
